WITH bounds AS (

months AS (

  FROM bounds
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT mo.m, COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS total_units
  FROM months mo
  LEFT JOIN sales_daily s ON date_trunc('month', s.day) = mo.m

),
compared AS (

)

JOIN stock s ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.name
ORDER BY SUM(s.on_hand) DESC, w.name ASC
LIMIT 1
